neighbours.label: the token ' beyond' (weak, broad early-layer unit)
fire: The hikers wanted to see what lay beyond the mountains.
Her talent goes far beyond simple technical skill.
The village sits just beyond the old stone bridge.
This problem is beyond the scope of the present report.
They sailed beyond the horizon in search of new land.
His generosity extended well beyond his own family.
The results were beyond anything the team had expected.
Few travellers ever ventured beyond the desert's edge.
quiet: The hikers wanted to see what lay behind the mountains.

The village sits just past the old stone bridge.
This problem is outside the scope of the present report.
They sailed toward the horizon in search of new land.
His generosity reached people outside his own family.
The results were better than the team had expected.
Few travellers ever went past the desert's edge.
